labels.look: Off-white, two columns: Dyslexia Week badge plus mission paragraph; email, phone per country, social links; sticky nav overlaps
labels.learn: Use the footer to restate the cause (dyslexia awareness week), not only contact details

labels.variantDefinition: A row or grid of short looping square videos, one per design topic (kerning, punctuation, diacritics), each animating that detail on a glyph pair
labels.look: Three lavender squares on yellow, white outlined 'Tw', 'Q?', 'Ęę' (still frames of looping videos)
labels.ux: Autoplay muted looping videos; static otherwise
labels.learn: One micro-animation per topic (kerning, diacritics) lets a visitor grasp each decision in a few seconds

labels.look: Peach card on grey: role/name credit list and special thanks left; 'We have charming faces!' at Small, Medium, Large, Xtra Large right
labels.learn: Pair the credits with a pun waterfall ('We have charming faces!') so the people and the optical sizes share one spread

labels.look: Capture shows a fixed layer of grey serif term columns A-Z ('Anatomy... Zone') and side alphabet rail; colophon text itself not visible
labels.ux: Editor's note, credits, links to other minisites, shop and trial links (from HTML)
labels.learn: An editor's note explaining how the content mirrors the optical sizes ties the site's structure to the font's

labels.look: White, two-column joke thanks ('The internet for making so many things possible'), then a giant black cropped 'END'
labels.learn: Literally ending on 'END' in the heaviest weight is a last specimen and a punchline at once

labels.look: Dark, mono licence FAQ ('May I use it in my logotype? -> YES'), Credits row, social icons, legal; teal cookie modal covers the middle
labels.ux: Read FAQ; credits; social and legal links; language switch
labels.learn: Answer licence questions as yes/no FAQ lines in the font itself: legal clarity plus a mono specimen

labels.look: Off-white, one giant black cropped glyph filling the frame, tiny copyright and 'Website by' lines, nav with Invert Colors and Get the font
labels.ux: Invert colours toggle; 'Get the font' button; table of contents rail
labels.learn: Close on a single glyph so large it becomes abstract shape: the font's drawing quality is the final word

labels.look: Near-black corporate footer: newsletter teaser, Platform/Ecosystem/Support/Company link columns, legal row, social icons
labels.learn: Brand-owned microsites inherit the parent site's global footer; the specimen ends where the brand begins

labels.look: Two rows of bold Bauhaus-coloured cards: posters, airport wayfinding 'Exit A', '18 weights 200 languages', spiral of 9s
labels.learn: A moving strip of flat applications (signage, posters, stats) shows breadth without asking the visitor to scroll
